security_privacy_cost_impact: NO SCHEMA, POLICY, GRANT OR ROLE CHANGES (A1 verified this independently). The pass runs each block as the connecting role inside a transaction that is rolled back; A1 measured three extra passes leave the database, roles and ACLs identical. A replacement is refused at runtime unless it is exactly one block with no psql meta-command line (A1 F2). The README says a register diff that relaxes a security assertion goes to the Security reviewer; whether that is a gate is the Owner's (integration record §4).
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. No migration is added or edited; the set is unchanged at 000..140. migrate-clean does more work after applying it (about one second more on a fresh cluster) and fails where an earlier batch's apply-time assertion no longer holds.
compatibility_impact: migrate-clean can now FAIL on a migration set it used to accept, which is the point: a future batch that makes an earlier block false must add a register entry and an additive replacement in the same change (README). Isolation cases unmoved at 965; foundation-contract 63 -> 67 tests and 258 -> 288 assertions; .github/workflows/ci.yml untouched.
known_limitations: THE PASS RE-RUNS WHAT BLOCKS SAY AND MAKES NO BLOCK STRONGER. A block asserting that a constraint exists by name misses a change to what it says, and closures are checked for tokens (A1 F3, Q0 F5): three updated_by closures gutted with `or true` were caught by neither layer. Blocker.

MOST LATER-FILE DRIFT TOUCHES THINGS NO BLOCK NAMES: twelve of Q0's fourteen surviving drifts (SECURITY DEFINER search_path outside app_authz, security_events triggers disabled, unasserted CHECKs, NOT NULL drops). Blocker 188; Q0's structural remedy is a live catalog snapshot for 011-140.
No CI run yet shows the pass can fail: the control job needs ci.yml, the Integration Owner's file, and is proposed in the integration record §5.
A pin ADDED in a replacement can be deleted unnoticed: the additive test protects the original's lines, not the added ones (Q0 F9). Review reads it.
Every role run is a same-vendor subagent of the Author under the Author's brief, and says so in its §0.
open_risks_or_blockers: OPENED: the name-or-token survey owed before batch 150, now carrying A1 F3 and Q0 F5 (replaces the D01h blocker, which this pass closes); and 188, drift in things no block names (Q0 F4, F6, F7).
FOR THE OWNER: whether a security-relaxing register change requires A1 as a gate; A1 F3's MEDIUM against A1-090's LOW. The three decisions owed from batch 121 are unchanged.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert pull request; no database object is involved, so a revert only removes the pass and returns migrate-clean to what it accepted before. NEVER a force-push. A register entry that turns out wrong is a forward fix in invariants/, never an edit to a migration.

reviewer_instructions: START WITH evidence/WP-0A-DB-00/a0-post-migrate-pass-integration-2026-09-27.md: every role-run finding and what happened to it.

READ THE REPLACEMENTS AS DIFFS AGAINST THEIR ORIGINALS: each is the original block plus lines marked SUPERSEDED BY; a test holds them additive, and a reviewer judges whether each added exclusion is what the named later file requires.
MEASURE ON THE BRANCH NAME, NEVER DETACHED: a detached HEAD skips the handoff and branch-scope guards and reads false green.
A LIVE CHECK needs a fresh cluster per round (roles are cluster-wide): shim, then `make db-migrate-clean`, then `make db-rls-smoke`. To see it fail, append a drift to 140_audit.sql, not a new file.
